items.headline: Chiefs laud Kenneth Walker III's impact through 2-0 start
items.description: For a second straight week, offseason acquisition Kenneth Walker III demonstrated how he has helped revitalize the Kansas City offense, tallying 178 all-purpose yards in the Chiefs' 33-30 overtime win against the Colts.

items.headline: Colts' Shane Steichen defends OT playcalling in loss to Chiefs
items.description: Colts coach Shane Steichen defended his late-game strategy and playcalling in Sunday night's 33-30 overtime loss to the Chiefs, saying he would have gone for the win on fourth-and-8 had Kansas City showed a favorable defensive coverage.
